notes.settlementToken: WHSK (0xB210...1Cf1, official wrapped HSK). The demo wallets could not get USDC.e/USDT on HashKey within budget (Meson USDT pool on HashKey was empty, no other API route). The code is token-agnostic; set USDC_ADDRESS=0x054ed45810DbBAb8B27668922D110669c9D88D0a for USDC.e.
notes.coordinator: HSP Coordinator API key not available to the team at run time, so the Coordinator step (register mandate + observe transfer) ran in LocalCoordinator, which performs the same checks (EIP-712 signature, chain, deadline, matching Transfer log, confirmations) against the HashKey mainnet RPC. paymentId is the EIP-712 struct hash of the mandate. Registry deploy, agent registration, token transfer and recordSettlement anchor are real HashKey mainnet transactions.
